summary: Requirements are decided and the Design 2.0 screens are ready for your review. Next we pick the accent colour, then start building the app.

updates.text: **The Journey Hub** replaces Figma: screens, design system, cues, inspiration, requirements, roadmap and tech in one page, built from the repo. Comment buttons added.
**Design 2.0**: real photos, bold type, glass controls, light and dark, three accent colours to choose from.
**Requirements finalized** with your eight decisions: both audiences, short video clips, worldwide in English, free with no ads.
First designs (v1) in Figma: a warm paper look. Replaced by Design 2.0 after your review.
Requirements, tech stack, roadmap and design brief written from your earlier AI discussions.
Project started, with its own cloud environment.
